[doc-01#c0] Vellmar Station was established in 1962 by the Kessner Maritime Trust on the northern shore of Hallen Island. It was the first permanent installation in the Kessner Archipelago and remains the administrative centre for the six northern stations.

[doc-12#c0] Kelvinmoor Peat Observatory was established in 1974 on the blanket bog of the Kelvinmoor plateau. It is the only inland station in the archipelago.

[doc-24#c0] Wexcombe Station was established in 1987 on a raised beach terrace on the southern coast of Wexcombe Island.

[doc-20#c1] The depot holds emergency rations, fuel and spare parts, and is inspected twice a year by a team from Vellmar Station.
